mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: We primarily use high-quality, durable latex (water-based) paints for most interior projects. These paints offer excellent coverage, durability, and are low in VOCs (volatile organic compounds), making them a good choice for indoor environments. We can also discuss oil-based options or specific brands if you have a preference.
